name: bare-metadata
description: Clean site with every page stripped of JSON-LD, meta description and Open Graph tags; the home page is titled 'Home' and carries two h1s; three of four product screenshots lack alt text; the pricing FAQ is removed. All key facts remain present as plain text.

expected.notes: Metadata defects only: the facts themselves are extractable from text, so key_fact_missing and image_only pass. jsonld.missing fires once for the whole site and the three dependent JSON-LD checks are not_evaluated (dependency_failed) with no finding. title generic on home only ('Home'); h1 multiple on home only (2); meta_description and og missing on all six pages; alt_text_missing on product (3 of 4 content images; the 32px logo is too small to count). The four screenshots carry no fact signal in alt or filename, so image_only stays quiet.
